lines: Airbnb's founders designed their own cereal boxes
for the US presidential election: Obama O's and Cap'n McCain's.
They sold them at $40 a box, more than 1,000 boxes,
according to Airbnb's chief executive, Brian Chesky.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Airbnb's founders once sold cereal at $40 a box, to stay afloat.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: And not just any cereal: the boxes were Obama O's and Cap'n McCain's, made for that year's US election. So why was a website for spare rooms selling breakfast?

items.title: Airbnb CEO says he wooed first investors with boxes of cereal

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Then the cereal won over Y Combinator, the start-up school. It put in $20,000 for 6% of Airbnb.
